This guide is for vendors: claiming your listing, then working in the vendor portal. If your company has not claimed its listing yet, start with [For vendors](/docs/vendors/overview) and [Claiming your vendor listing](/docs/vendors/claiming-your-listing). If you read the directory or write reviews, the [General guide](/docs) is for you.

## Current limits

Some things the vendor portal does not do yet:

- **Removing a data flow you added.** A corrected row you added stays on record after you cancel the change or pick another direction. It shows again as a row with no answer from you. Readers do not see it until a company says Yes to it again or AEC Integrations lists it. See [Confirming integration data](/docs/vendors/confirming-integration-data#when-the-direction-is-wrong).
- **Conversations on a change request.** Each side sees the other's reason, note and reply, but there is no back-and-forth. See [Requesting changes and appeals](/docs/vendors/requesting-changes-and-appeals).
- **Adding a catalog match.** On a connector product's **Catalog** tab, you cannot add a match to a listing that has none. We add those. See [For connector vendors](/docs/vendors/connector-vendors).
